egress.free_allowance: 5 GB monthly transfer on Free, 50 GB on Plus at CNY 390 per month, 200 GB on Pro at CNY 980 per month.

interface_detail: 'The CLI supports Windows and Linux; Launcher is for Windows.', plus automation tokens on the pricing table
tooling: Proxlane CLI and a Windows Launcher
chaining: The CLI runs on Linux, so a free VM can host the origin; the UDP port still needs Plus.

limits.value: UDP is 'Not included' on Free and 'Fixed UDP ports' is 0; Plus is required

binding_note: At 1 TiB/month the byte allowance is irrelevant because the free tier carries no UDP at all: the plan is what fails first, and the earliest plan with one fixed UDP port is Plus.

identity_cost.detail: An account plus a device approval: 'proxlane login' and 'approve this device with proxlane login'.

reliability_note: Free tier is one active tunnel and one device-attached agent; the public UDP port on Plus is a fixed port, one per account.
confidence_note: The free plan's protocol list and the vendor's own Bedrock answer both state the gate, so the verdict is settled; only a paid account would show the port behaviour.

evidence.proved: Free plan rows: 'Protocols HTTP / TCP', 'Fixed UDP ports 0', 'UDP Not included', 'Monthly transfer 5 GB'; Plus lists 'Protocols HTTP / TCP / UDP', 'Fixed UDP ports 1', 'Monthly transfer 50 GB'
'UDP forwarding and public port allocation are enabled on Plus and Pro. Free can publish HTTP and TCP within its active-tunnel limit but cannot start a Bedrock UDP profile.'
'The public port may not be the same as local port 19132.', so even a paid plan hands out a rewritten port on a shared edge

notes: The paid Plus plan does carry one fixed UDP port, so this vendor is a free-tier gap rather than a protocol refusal. Prices are quoted in CNY on an English page. The free tier's 5 GB is, so the plan gate and the quota both fail the tests and the plan gate is the one met first.

extras.wg_detail: No WireGuard, and the free tier has no UDP endpoint to put one behind.
extras.volume_stated: 5 GB monthly transfer on Free, 50 GB on Plus at CNY 390 per month, 200 GB on Pro at CNY 980 per month.
extras.transit_note: Proxlane's relay carries the bytes and rewrites the port.
